description: This source file implements JSON response helper functions for error handling, timestamp generation, and JSON timestamp conversion within the JsonResponses namespace.

methods.name: malFormedRequest
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a malformed request with error details.

methods.name: notSetResponse
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating that a requested value is not set.

methods.name: pathNotFound
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a requested path was not found.

methods.name: noAccess
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating access is forbidden.

methods.name: valueOutOfBounds
methods.description: Creates a JSON response indicating a value is out of bounds.

methods.name: getTimeStamp
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp in ISO8601 format.

methods.name: getTimeStampZero
methods.description: Returns a zero (epoch) timestamp in ISO8601 format.

methods.name: addTimeStampToJSON
methods.description: Adds timestamp attributes to a JSON object.

methods.name: convertJSONTimeStampToISO8601
methods.description: Converts ts_s and ts_ns attributes in JSON to an ISO8601 timestamp.
